facts.fact: Namibia's Ministry of ICT told the Financial Sector Council Advisory Body it is ready to implement Electronic Identification and to launch a Public Key Infrastructure for legally recognised electronic signatures.

NAM.note: Document says nothing on civil register and ID links.
Names only a financial sector strategy 2025-2035, not a national digital strategy.
No law named; only says PKI enables legally recognised e-signatures, no law or draft stated.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
Electronic ID is only prepared for implementation; no system issuing unique credentials is stated.
